title: SpawnShield
description: Temporary invulnerability on join and respawn.
body:
# SpawnShield

Temporary invulnerability on join and respawn.

## Features
- Temporary damage immunity after join or respawn.
- Configurable duration and messages.
- Optional title display.
- Lightweight and server-safe.

## Command
- `/spawnshield status | /spawnshield reload`

## Permissions
- `spawnshield.use`
- `spawnshield.bypass`
- `spawnshield.admin`

## Config (snippet)
```yml
duration-seconds: 6
enable-on-join: true
enable-on-respawn: true
```

## Compatibility
- Server: Paper, Spigot, Purpur
- Minecraft: 1.16.5 - 1.21.4

## Install
1. Drop the jar into `plugins/`.
2. Restart the server.
3. Edit `config.yml` and run the reload command.
